mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.external_key AS "externalKey", s.topic_id AS "topicId", s.language, s.library_name AS "libraryName", s.version_label AS "versionLabel", s.title, s.summary, COUNT(a.id) AS "annotationCount" FROM source_snippet s LEFT JOIN source_annotation a ON a.source_snippet_id = s.id WHERE s.status = 'ENABLED' AND s.topic_id = #{topicId} AND s.version_label = #{version} GROUP BY s.id ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC, s.id DESC

SELECT id, external_key AS "externalKey", topic_id AS "topicId", language, library_name AS "libraryName", version_label AS "versionLabel", source_path AS "sourcePath", title, summary, code_text AS "codeText", start_line AS "startLine", end_line AS "endLine", license_name AS "licenseName" FROM source_snippet WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ENABLED'
SELECT id, line_start AS "lineStart", line_end AS "lineEnd", title, explanation FROM source_annotation WHERE source_snippet_id = #{sourceSnippetId} ORDER BY sort_order, id
